content: July 18, 2024 Welcome Packet About Welcome to an elite team that is working with CDC to improve public health worldwide. Please read the information included in this Welcome Packet closely. It includes important instructions, guidelines, and key requirements of your grant or cooperative agreement award. About these resources Dear Recipient, Congratulations on your award! Welcome to an elite team that is working with CDC to improve public health worldwide. Please read the information included in this Welcome Packet closely. It includes important instructions, guidelines, and key requirements that are critical to the success of your grant or cooperative agreement award (" award "). This Welcome Packet is divided into the actions you, the grant recipient , would take upon receiving your award. Each section will contain bolded and underlined links that you can use to get additional information. Please click on each section below as you read through the Welcome Packet. On behalf of CDC, we would like to congratulate you on your grant award and wish you the best of success as you work towards supporting our nation's public health. It is important to remember that every grant is unique. Please refer to your Notice of Award (NoA) for specific details regarding your grant. Should you have any additional questions, please reach out to your POCs listed in your NoA.
